q1_issues.issue: The definite "the representative" keeps its typing atom (Member sk_representative_1 representative) inside the Whether seal, although a definite referent's Member/Name typing must project to top level in every sealing construct alike (the Palestinian people's typing was projected, so the parse is internally inconsistent too).

q2_gaps: predicative "as"-complement of a verb ("treat Arafat as the representative"): no licensed encoding, so the parse mints a separate representative witness that is never identified with Arafat
a numeric division/split figure ("divided 3-1"): no head records the ratio; only the rest's Cardinality 3 survives and the 1-side is left implicit
a deontic "should" inside a seal: the prescribed strength 0.7 has no carrier, since a sealed conjunct takes no truth value
notes: The adjective-with-PP-complement route (flat (Member sk_group_1 divided) + reified state + On complement) and the RestOf/SubsetOf remainder shape both follow the instruction set, and the discourse-initial "But" correctly gets no connective atom. Against, On, As and Of are all surface prepositions and stay inside the open-class oblique licence.
